changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.18[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: Preview[/COLOR]
-Long press OK on the remote, or long press on a touch screen, on a movie, show, season or episode of luc_kodi: Kodi's context menu now has "luc_kodi  Preview".
-Preview opens over the poster wall and closing it leaves you where you were.
-The window is laid out on an even grid. Top left: the title's poster and line, the clearlogo (or the title in large type), the ratings with their icons (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, TMDb and Trakt, only the ones the title has) and the tagline.
-Top right: the trailer plays inside the window, in a 16:9 box. The fanart shows during a short countdown, then the trailer starts by itself. A YouTube badge shows that trailers come from YouTube.
-Below: the synopsis across the whole width, which scrolls by itself when it is long, and three buttons: Play (Open for a show or season), Full-screen trailer and More options, which opens the luc_kodi context panel. The context key also opens it.
-The trailer is the same one as the Trailer entry, with the same language and "official trailers only" settings. If one does not start, the next one is tried. Nothing starts by itself when something else is already playing, and closing the window stops the trailer.
-For episodes the trailer box shows the show's fanart, never the episode's own picture, and the plot of an unwatched episode stays hidden.
-Settings > Navigation > Preview: show or hide the entry, start the trailer after 3, 5 or 8 seconds or only with the button, trailer sound on or off, and hide the plot of unwatched episodes.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-PunchPlay Manager: Mark as watched failed with "PunchPlay could not do that" for every movie and episode, because PunchPlay requires the title with each watch and the Manager did not send it. It now sends the title and year of the movie, or the show's title for an episode, and asks PunchPlay's catalogue for the title when it is missing.
-Menu windows (Managers, Playlist, Rescrape Options) no longer write "Control 9601 ... asked to focus, but it can't" to the log each time they open.
